scope: A disposable source Kind cluster and separately owned peer Kind cluster host pinned local Distribution registries. The source signs the SAF-K8S-0910-024 inert model metadata using a per-run key; a transfer client copies bytes and reports success. The destination then substitutes only inert metadata while retaining the signed statement. With enforcement off, a named Kubernetes Job consumes the substituted bytes. With enforcement on, a separate peer pod re-fetches the actual destination manifest and blob, checks the reference, Distribution digest headers, descriptor, source digest and RSA signature against a locally mounted trusted public key, and blocks the Job. A clean readback is also consumed by an independent named Job. No external registry, production credential, model payload, or inference execution is involved.

checks.claim: Without destination enforcement, a success claim permits substituted bytes to be consumed
Destination readback policy blocks use despite source success
A clean independently verified destination artifact remains usable
